name: Kanaami 2 -Iinchou Kana no Baai-
original_name: カナアミ2 -委員長 香奈の場合-
source:
A simple straightforward R-18 sex training simulator. 

Use commands to break the spirit of a captive girl in an empty warehouse. 

The protagonist transferred to a new school with a lot of girls. But the girls rejected his presence, spearheaded by a hateful leader. 

She was the class president, Kana. 
Driven to a corner, the protagonist snapped and abducted Kana. 
In an abandoned warehouse outside town he began to punish her commensurate with the disdain she showed him at school. 

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng-touch/work/=/product_id/RE170756.html]DLsite English[/url]]

一款简单直接的R-18性爱训练模拟器。

使用命令，在空仓库里摧毁被囚女孩的精神。

主人公转学到一所女孩子很多的新学校，但女孩们在一名憎恨他的领袖带头下排斥他的存在。

她就是班长香。
